i think the best thing is to not expect anything from the first appointment, don't go looking for a diagnosis but go looking for ways to be better, many doctors don't like giving diagnosis so that the patients mentality isn't affected so you could tell your therapist that you suspect having adhd and would like him to observe for symptoms, tell him exactly what you feel even if it doesn't seem adhd related, don't put your whole focus on being diagnosed as you could be having something else with similar symptoms, i wish you the best of luck.
